authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

rules.title: Name of Food on Principal Display Panel
rules.name: Name of Food on Principal Display Panel
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Every pre-packaged food shall bear the name of the food on the Principal Display Panel which indicates the true nature of the food.
rules.description: True nature and description of the food (e.g. Granola) must appear prominently on the PDP.

rules.title: Mandatory Green Vegetarian Logo (Veg Mark)
rules.name: Mandatory Green Vegetarian Logo (Veg Mark)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Every package of 'Vegetarian Food' shall bear a declaration to this effect by a symbol in green colour consisting of a filled circle inside a square with green border.
rules.description: Vegetarian food must declare green square with filled green circle on PDP near product name.

rules.title: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit Licence Identifier
rules.name: 14-Digit FSSAI License Number and Logo
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The FSSAI logo and licence number of the brand owner shall be displayed on the label in the contrast of the background with 14 digits.
rules.description: FSSAI logo alongside 14-digit license number of manufacturer/importer must be displayed.

rules.title: Date of Manufacture / Packing and Best Before
rules.name: Date of Manufacture / Packing and Best Before
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Date of manufacture or packaging shall be declared along with 'Expiry Date' or 'Best Before' date.
rules.description: Date of manufacture/packing and 'Best Before ... months from packaging' must be declared.

rules.title: List of Ingredients in Descending Order of Weight
rules.name: List of Ingredients in Descending Order of Weight
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The list of ingredients shall be declared in descending order of incoming weight (m/m) at the time of the manufacture of the food.
rules.description: Ingredients must be declared in descending order of incoming weight at time of manufacture.

rules.title: Nutritional Information per 100g and per Serve with % RDA
rules.name: Nutritional Information per 100g and per Serve with % RDA
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Nutritional information shall be given on the label per 100g or 100ml or per single consumption pack of the food and per serve percentage contribution to RDA.
rules.description: Energy, protein, carbohydrates, total sugars, added sugars, total fat, saturated fat, sodium per 100g and % RDA.

rules.title: Energy Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.name: Energy Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Schedule II
rules.sourceQuote: Average reference energy intake for adults is 2000 kcal per day as prescribed by ICMR-NIN.
rules.description: Reference energy value for adult diet is 2000 kcal per ICMR-NIN RDA guidelines.

rules.title: Added Sugars Threshold & % RDA Check
rules.name: Added Sugars Threshold & % RDA Check
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Schedule II
rules.sourceQuote: Reference intake for added sugars is 25g per day. Products containing added caloric sweeteners must disclose added sugars.
rules.description: Reference Daily Intake for added sugars is 25g. Products with added honey cannot claim zero added sugar.

rules.title: Total Fat Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.name: Total Fat Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Schedule II
rules.sourceQuote: Reference intake for total fat is 30g per day per ICMR-NIN RDA guidelines.
rules.description: Reference Daily Intake for Total Fat is 30g per ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA.

rules.title: Sodium Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.name: Sodium Reference Value (% RDA Check)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Schedule II
rules.sourceQuote: Reference daily intake for sodium is 2000 mg per day.
rules.description: Reference Daily Intake for Sodium is 2000 mg per day.

rules.title: Allergen Declaration of Tree Nuts and Cereals
rules.name: Allergen Declaration of Tree Nuts and Cereals
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: Foods containing cereals containing gluten and tree nuts shall declare allergens distinctly in bold font or in an allergen advisory box.
rules.description: Cereals containing gluten (oats) and tree nuts (almonds) must be declared in bold or highlighted font.

rules.title: Batch / Lot Identification Code
rules.name: Batch / Lot Identification Code
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: A batch number or code number or lot number which is a mark of identification by which the food can be traced shall be declared.
rules.description: Batch or code number must be preceded by 'Batch No.' or 'Lot No.' or 'B. No.'

rules.title: Storage Condition Instructions
rules.name: Storage Condition Instructions
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
rules.sourceQuote: The instructions for storage shall be declared on the label to ensure that the food maintains its quality until the best before date.
rules.description: Specific storage instructions required to maintain product quality (e.g. Store in cool, dry place).

rules.title: Restrictions on Sugar and Honey Claims
rules.name: Restrictions on Sugar and Honey Claims
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018
rules.sourceQuote: A claim that food contains 'No Added Sugars' shall not be made if the food contains added sugars, honey, molasses, or concentrated fruit juices.
rules.description: Claims of 'No Added Sugars' are prohibited if the food contains ingredients like honey that contribute sugars.

rules.title: FSSAI Vegan Logo Authorization and Claim Verification
rules.name: FSSAI Vegan Logo and Claim Approval
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Vegan Foods) Regulations, 2022
rules.sourceQuote: No person shall manufacture, pack, sell, offer for sale, market or distribute or import any food as vegan food unless they comply with the requirements... and bear the Vegan logo approved by the Authority.
rules.description: Vegan food claims in India require FSSAI verification; private certification marks do not replace statutory endorsement.

rules.title: FSSAI 2027 FOPNL Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) Star Rating
rules.name: FSSAI 2027 FOPNL Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) Star Rating
rules.sourceLaw: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Amendment Regulations, 2026
rules.citation: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Amendment Regulations 2027, Reg. 5(3)
rules.sourceQuote: Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) shall present the Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) star rating from 0.5 to 5 stars alongside high salt, sugar, or saturated fat warning indicators.
rules.description: Mandatory Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) star emblem (0.5 to 5 stars) and high-sugar/fat/sodium warning thresholds for packaged granola.
